cells.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from terminating a residential tenancy without just cause, categorized into at-fault and no-fault reasons. For no-fault evictions, landlords must provide relocation assistance equal to two to three months of actual rent.
It is unlawful to sell, license, or provide an algorithmic rent-setting device to a landlord, or for a landlord to use such a device using nonpublic competitor data to set rates or occupancy levels.
cells.key_value: civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

cells.requirement: It is unlawful for any person to sell, license, or provide an algorithmic device to a landlord, and unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
Landlords cannot discriminate against tenants or prospective tenants based on their source of income, including government or nonprofit rental assistance programs.
